nodes.summary: Let $n \ge 1$ and let $A$ be a positive semidefinite complex $n \times n$ matrix. Then $(\operatorname{Re} \det A)^{1/n} = \operatorname{Re}(\operatorname{tr} A)/n$ if and only if $A = cI$ for some real number $c \ge 0$, where $I$ is the $n \times n$ identity matrix.
nodes.title: Equality in the AM–GM bound for the determinant

nodes.summary: Let $n \ge 1$ and let $A$ be a positive semidefinite complex $n \times n$ matrix. Then $\operatorname{Re} \det A \le (\operatorname{Re}(\operatorname{tr} A)/n)^n$.
nodes.title: AM–GM inequality for the determinant of a positive semidefinite matrix, power form

nodes.summary: Let $A$ be a positive semidefinite complex $n \times n$ matrix. Then the real part of the determinant of $A$ is at most the product of the real parts of its diagonal entries: $\operatorname{Re} \det A \le \prod_{i=1}^{n} \operatorname{Re} A_{ii}$.
nodes.title: Hadamard's inequality for positive semidefinite matrices

nodes.summary: Let $n \ge 1$ and let $A$ be a positive semidefinite complex $n \times n$ matrix. Then $(\operatorname{Re} \det A)^{1/n} \le \operatorname{Re}(\operatorname{tr} A)/n$.
